# Championship season: STARTS A NEW SEASON, team, round info, standings, in-season Options and Controls, cancel a restart
# Generated by scripts/gen-nav-tours.py, each button checked against
# UIData/gtr2ui.mnu. Start on MAIN MENU.
# SEASON TOUR: starts or changes championship progress. Run only with:  gtr2-nav.py path --season-step FILE
# (a plain run refuses). Revert the profile afterwards with git (UserData/<profile>, Championships). 'A=B' = buttons of map page A, screen checked against reference B.
# Format: PAGE | LABEL | EXPECTED PAGE   (a label '@x,y' is a canvas position)

TEAM_SELECT_CHAMP | SUMMARY | SUMMARY_CHAMP
SUMMARY_CHAMP | CONTINUE | NEXTROUND_CHAMP
NEXTROUND_CHAMP | STANDINGS | DRIVERSTANDING_CHAMP
DRIVERSTANDING_CHAMP | TEAM | TEAMSTANDINGS_CHAMP
TEAMSTANDINGS_CHAMP | ROUND INFO | NEXTROUND_CHAMP
NEXTROUND_CHAMP | OPTIONS | OPTIONS_BASIC_CHAMP
OPTIONS_BASIC_CHAMP | VIDEO | OPTIONS_DETAIL_CHAMP
OPTIONS_DETAIL_CHAMP | AUDIO | OPTIONS_AUDIO_CHAMP
OPTIONS_AUDIO_CHAMP | ADVANCED | OPTIONS_ADVANCED_CHAMP
OPTIONS_ADVANCED_CHAMP | REALISM | OPTIONS_ASSISTS_CHAMP
OPTIONS_ASSISTS_CHAMP | CONTROLS | CONTROL_KEYS_CHAMP
